purpose: Select a safe recorder stop threshold before building the common EVT image without circularly requiring that image to have already passed EVT C.
selection_rule: For every pack, derive the minimum terminal voltage at which SYS, V3V3, MCU, storage writes and file finalization remain inside their qualified limits under the 110mA peak.
Add measured ADC error, rail transient and repeatability margin; selected_cutoff_mv must be at or above the worst-pack resulting minimum_safe_cutoff_mv.
At 25C every pack must deliver at least 70.4mAh before reaching selected_cutoff_mv under the conservative load profile.

After controlled finalization every pack must enter Standby with charge request and LED off; completed-device battery current must be <=150uA. This is a prototype acceptance ceiling, not a measured result or an indefinite-storage guarantee.
With PA0 VBUS_N configured as active-low WKUP1, USB insertion must reset-wake within 1000ms and recover 9-11mA charging without corrupting completed files.

The selected threshold is only a build input. The final common image must then pass EVT C on all five complete devices for at least 57600 seconds; failure requires a new image and complete Gate C restart.
release_rule: Characterization alone never proves 16h runtime. It only authorizes building the EVT image; EVT C remains mandatory on all five completed units.
